record.question: To run riot
record.explanation: Answer D: behave in an undisciplined way. To run riot means to behave wildly or without control; “behave in an undisciplined way” is the closest option (D). Independent check: “Run riot” means behave wildly or without control; “behave in an undisciplined way” is the broad match. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/run-riot.
